options.COOPERATE: Synchronize switch timings with the dispatcher to ensure smooth shared corridor passage.
options.INDEPENDENT: Proceed through junctions using standard uncoupled signal protocols independently.
options.COMPETE_EXPLOIT: Override signals at each junction to delay freight and secure priority passage.
options.DISENGAGE: Delay passenger trains at the terminal until freight traffic has fully cleared.
